description: This file contains test data for a chat completion model, including multiple 'ModelResponse' instances with 'StreamingChoices' and 'Delta' content, as well as references to external utility functions and classes related to chat responses and tool calls.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: Represents a chunk of a chat completion response, including choices and metadata.

classes.name: StreamingChoices
classes.description: Contains individual choices within a streaming chat response, including delta content.

classes.name: Delta
classes.description: Represents incremental content in a streamed chat response, including role, content, and potential tool calls.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Defines a callable or command related to the chat or tool call.

classes.name: ChatCompletionDeltaToolCall
classes.description: Represents a tool call within a chat delta, with specific function and arguments.
